skill_slot_steel.layer: over the icon (the window is transparent; his gold brackets overlap the icon corners). Drawn under the icon it works too, the brackets are then hidden where the icon covers them.
skill_slot_steel.at2x: on a 2x screen: the frame doubled (nearest, 112x112, slices 32) and the @2x icon in its 88x88 window at 12,12
skill_slot_steel.use: His skill slot from the icon picture: dark steel bar with a lit outer edge, his thin gold line inside, gold corner brackets with steel rivets. The skill icon goes in the window.

skill_slot_steel_active.use: The same slot, selected or hovered: the steel turns gold and the rivets glint (as the kit pairs skill_slot with skill_slot_active).
